title: Cottage Cheese + Peanut Butter Brownie Cheesecake
description: A protein-packed dessert that sits between a fudgy brownie and a creamy cheesecake - no flour needed.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, bananas, eggs, peanut butter, vanilla, and honey until completely smooth.
Add the cocoa powder, protein powder, baking powder, and salt. Blend briefly until just combined.
Pour into a lined 18-20cm (7-8 inch) cake tin.
Swirl an extra 10-15g of peanut butter over the top for more peanut-butter flavour.
Bake for 30-40 minutes. The centre should still have a slight wobble when it comes out - it firms up as it chills.
Let it cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours, ideally overnight.
tips: No flour needed - the banana, eggs, and cottage cheese give it enough structure, while the cocoa gives it brownie character.
Use very ripe bananas - they add sweetness and moisture.
Don't overbake. A slightly underdone centre becomes beautifully fudgy after chilling.
Protein powder is genuinely optional: skip it for a softer, more cheesecake-like texture, or keep it for a firmer, more protein-heavy bake.
If your cottage cheese is particularly watery, drain it for 15-30 minutes first.
For a lighter, less intense chocolate-peanut flavour, dial back to 60g peanut butter and 25g cocoa instead.
